tools.short_description: Start a non-blocking repository-wide architectural analysis and return its job ID. Use get_analysis_status to poll completion and coverage.
Start non-blocking analysis limited to one directory layer and return its job ID. Use this instead of a global run when the decision is package-scoped.
Start non-blocking deep analysis for one Python file and return its job ID. Do not exclude the target file.

Return durable analysis-job status, coverage and LIVE publication state. Explicit job_id is authoritative; when omitted, multiple queued/running jobs return bounded ambiguous_job candidates instead of guessing.
Return revisioned desktop/MCP LIVE events after a known revision. When desktop watcher runs, poll this instead of calling update_file.
Apply one incremental architectural update when desktop watcher is not running. Requires a completed analysis and may report deferred analytics.
Return the highest-level canonical architecture summary with explicit availability per analytics family. Unavailable families never fabricate zero counts.
Return compact canonical metrics and dependency context for one module. Artifact identities are redirected to get_artifact_blast_radius.
Resolve confirmed direct static consumers and downstream module reachability for one artifact. Dynamic Python usage is not claimed as complete.
Search canonical LIVE modules and artifacts by a partial term with bounded dependency and consumer evidence. Narrow broad truncated matches before raising limits.

Preview or fetch one exact AST-bounded symbol implementation. Unique plain leaves may resolve through canonical LIVE identity; explicit file scope remains supported. Source is read from disk and ambiguous matches are never guessed.
Return canonical API, dependency, consumer, and test context before editing one file or module. Minimal mode is an in-memory decision projection.
Return isolation metrics, clusters, and boundary leaks for one architectural layer. Reports may enrich results but canonical LIVE state supplies structural fallback.
Compare architectural metrics from the last two analysis runs. An empty diff means no tracked metric changed, not identical source.

Discover the full canonical-query schema: roots, selectable fields, per-field operators, null semantics, ordering, limits and v1.1 capabilities. Optional for basic v1.0 query_canonical_projection requests.

Query canonical LIVE data. Basic request: root=modules|artifacts|dependencies, filters=[{field,operator,value}] (flat AND; []=all), select=[...] ([]=all). Omit both version fields for 1.0/1.0; use describe_canonical_state only for full/v1.1 discovery.
Resolve and return complete matching blocks from an indexed artifact report. Ambiguous or missing identities remain explicit.
Resolve selected compact module or artifact IDs without loading the whole registry. Recovery identities are historical, not active.
Return canonical artifacts for a module directly by dotted name, source path or active module ID, with optional bounded consumer evidence. No prior get_module_context lookup is required.
Find canonical artifacts by exact-preferred partial symbol matching with bounded consumer evidence. Narrow ambiguous names before increasing the limit.
Search literal text in canonical Python source and return bounded logical spans or compressed line maps.
Fetch one exact line range from a canonical Python source file with large-output confirmation.
Return a bounded callers/callees neighborhood from current canonical intra-module symbol-call facts without reading source.
Return centralized MCP documentation, optionally filtered by tool names and sections. This passive tool reads no repository, LIVE state, or output reports.
